name: US–China / Taiwan
value: No blockade; US tariff proposal 25 Nov
summary: US proposes 20% Section 301 tariff on China on 25 Nov; Taiwan watched a Chinese satellite launch path on 26 Nov
state: On 25 Nov the US Trade Representative proposed Section 301 tariffs of 20% on Chinese goods, rising to 40% if the trade truce expiring on 10 Jan unravels (Korea Times, Reuters). Taiwan said a Chinese satellite launched on 26 Nov was likely to cross its air defence zone (Taipei Times). Taiwan continues to report daily PLA aircraft and ship activity, but no blockade, clash or severed channel was found to 27 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Tension over Taiwan and trade is elevated but stable. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Major new US tariff measures proposed; no blockade or clash

sources.title: Korea Times (Reuters) — US proposes tariffs over excess production, retains 15% cap for Korea, Japan, EU
Taipei Times — Chinese satellite likely to fly over Taiwan's ADIZ on Thursday

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
